prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Last spring I was in Shanghai for a few days and basically just wandered around sightseeing.
Around that same time, my cousin was dealing with some clinic stuff over in Nanjing, so I kept hearing about that city nonstop.
And then later in the year I tagged along with friends in Chengdu, and we ended up talking about movies more than food, which is saying something.
In Shanghai, we did that classic photo walk at The Bund, and the tickets were under He Xia—there were 5 of us total.
I remember it was on 2025-03-16, and we went in the morning because the light was nicer and it was less crowded.
For my cousin’s Nanjing thing, the appointment was with Fang Ming, and it was for Xie Peng on 2025-04-25.
In Chengdu we also caught YOLO—John Smith bought 3 seats at Wanda Cinema Jinhua for the 20:30 showtime.
